result.title: Lang-SVG: Hierarchical Image Vectorization with Language Priors
result.summary: Image vectorization reconstructs raster images as compact scalable vector graph- ics (SVG), providing a structured and editable code representation of images. However, most existing vectorization methods optimize for pixel-level render- ing fidelity, often producing SVGs that lack alignment with human-perceived object-part hierarchies, making them difficult to manipulate. To address this, we propose Lang-SVG, which introduces an explicit tree structure to organize SVG primitives with semantic labels and parent-child relationships. Lang-SVG incorporates granularity-controllable and open-vocabulary segmentation priors to initialize object-part hierarchies and leverages multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with SVG tree context to assign semantic labels to unlabeled nodes. To reduce redundancy, we introduce depth-adaptive simplification to reduce shape complexity and Tree-Guided Pruning and Merging to eliminate redundant SVG nodes. L1-SAM-Prompting further recovers missing regions to improve recon- struction fidelity and structural completeness. Beyond reconstruction fidelity, we introduce a new evaluation protocol that measures structural quality and semantic part alignment. Experiments demonstrate that Lang-SVG achieves state-of-the-art performance in both rendering fidelity and structural quality. Project website: https://xiliu8006.github.io/Lang-SVG/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Lang-SVG，把光栅图矢量化输出组织成带语义标签和父子关系的显式树结构，借助可控粒度与开放词汇分割先验初始化物体-部件层级，并用 MLLM 补全未标注节点的语义标签，再以深度自适应简化与树引导的剪枝合并去除冗余，同时提出衡量结构与语义对齐的新评测协议。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作与 LVR 主线并不直接相关，但其把视觉内容组织为带语义层级的树状中间表示、并以可控粒度划分加剪枝合并控制细节冗余的做法，可能为结构化 latent 视觉状态的分层组织与粒度/停止决策提供可核查的思路。
